cases.description: A shared-thread copy: the summary carries the original author's preference; the copier states none.
transcript: This conversation is a copy of a shared thread. Before the copy point, the original author said they prefer all amounts in GBP.
Continue the analysis with the Q4 data.
Q4 added; amounts shown as in the original thread.

cases.description: After the copy point the person states their own preference, which differs from the original author's.
transcript: Copy of a shared thread. The original author asked for charts as bar charts.
I'll take it from here. I prefer line charts for anything over time.
Switching the time series to line charts.

expect.statement: Prefers line charts for time series.
expect.quote: I prefer line charts for anything over time.

cases.description: A fork of the person's own thread: a Workspace fact stated after the fork point counts.
transcript: Forked from an earlier conversation about Q2 budgets.
In this fork let's look at headcount. Note: contractors are not counted in headcount here, only employees.

expect.statement: Headcount counts employees only; contractors are excluded.
expect.quote: contractors are not counted in headcount here, only employees.

cases.description: The assistant recaps the original author's statements after the fork; the person never confirms.
transcript: What did the original thread conclude?
The original author concluded that the Workspace's discount ceiling is 15% and that only sales directors may exceed it.
OK. Now draft the proposal for the Kessler deal.

cases.description: The person explicitly confirms a recapped Workspace fact in their own words.
transcript: What did the original thread conclude?
It concluded the discount ceiling is 15%, and only sales directors may go above it.
Yes, that's right for our Workspace: 15% ceiling, directors only above that.

expect.statement: The discount ceiling is 15%; only sales directors may exceed it.
expect.quote: Yes, that's right for our Workspace: 15% ceiling, directors only above that.
expect.also_quote: It concluded the discount ceiling is 15%, and only sales directors may go above it.

cases.description: The copied part mentions a colleague's sick leave; nothing about it may become a memory.
transcript: Copy of a shared thread. Before the copy point: the report was delayed because Marta Silva is on sick leave until December.
Finish the report then. And I want the executive summary at the top, as always.
Executive summary moved to the top.

expect.statement: Wants the executive summary at the top of reports.
expect.quote: I want the executive summary at the top, as always.
